# Lumen — Warp's Design System

> Lumen is Warp's vertically-integrated UI design system spanning web (Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn), React Native, native iOS/Android, native desktop (macOS/Windows), and e-commerce themes (Shopify Liquid, BigCommerce Stencil, WooCommerce). Tokens are DTCG JSON; build pipeline is Style Dictionary v5; component contracts follow the shadcn registry spec. Visual mood (v0.12 Premium Psychology — Obsidian, mint retired): **cool-neutral paper white in light, neutral obsidian `#0D0D0D` in dark, one disciplined Spring Green accent `#00FA8A`** used for action / live / success only. Primary text on dark is `#E6E6E6` (the user-fixed brand light), not pure white. Seven design principles encode the 50ms halo effect, aggressive hierarchy, cognitive fluency, and the peak-end rule. **Status: v0.14.2 (2026-05-20)** — **R8b critical-CSS inlining for LCP round-trip elimination.** [ADR 0028](_meta/decisions/0028-inline-css-mobile-perf-v0135.md) codifies the ninth round of the audit-cycle ladder (R8a was the first follow-up on the R7 mobile-perf baseline; R8b is the second). R8b's tool axis: **Next.js 16's `experimental.inlineCss: true`** in [`audit-dashboard/next.config.ts`](/audit-dashboard/next.config.ts) — one config flag — replaces every prerendered page's `<link rel="stylesheet">` with a `<style data-precedence="next">` block in `<head>`, eliminating the render-blocking round-trip on first paint. **3-run-median results across 9 audit-dashboard routes at the Moto G4 4G profile: LCP geo-mean 3001 → 2706 ms (−295 ms, −9.8%).** Per-route LCP standouts: `/landing` 2954 → 1825 ms (−1129 ms), `/commerce` 2948 → 1898 ms (−1050 ms), `/desktop` −241 ms, `/mobile` −234 ms. **Speed Index dramatically improves on heavy routes:** `/` SI 2614 → 1483 ms (−1131 ms), `/library` SI 2575 → 1648 ms (−927 ms). **CLS contract held: 0.000 on every route, both configs** — both `@font-face` blocks (handcoded `Satoshi-Fallback` per ADR 0010 + next/font's `satoshi Fallback`) are preserved verbatim in the inlined CSS; metric overrides are font-table-derived not glyph-derived. **One regression — `/library` LCP +184 ms median:** main-thread CSS parse cost shifts from network thread to main thread, and on `/library`'s 4684-node DOM that shift doubles main-thread work (3138 → 6283 ms). Bounded: R8c carry-forward (`/library` DOM weight reduction via Intersection Observer lazy-rendering) is the root-cause fix. **Cumulative R8a + R8b: LCP 3030 → 2706 ms = −324 ms / −10.7% from the R7 baseline.** Methodology contribution: *byte-level levers also have shape — moving bytes between the network thread and the main thread changes WHERE the cost lands, not just WHETHER it lands. A round can be a clean win in aggregate while regressing on the heaviest route in the surface set; that regression is a signal for the NEXT lever, not a veto on the current one.* Plus: new [`scripts/lighthouse-mobile-baseline.mjs`](/scripts/lighthouse-mobile-baseline.mjs) factors the inline Lighthouse recipe into a re-runnable CLI (`--tag`, `--port`, `--routes` flags); `scripts/release.mjs --banner-only` flag (closes the chat 41 pre-author friction). Audit baseline at [`.audit-runs/2026-05-19-round-8b/LIGHTHOUSE.md`](/.audit-runs/2026-05-19-round-8b/LIGHTHOUSE.md). R8c+ candidates rank by expected LCP impact ÷ architectural-risk: (1) `/library` DOM weight reduction (Intersection Observer lazy-render — 300–500 ms LCP win, compensates R8b main-thread regression); (2) italic `font-display: optional` (brand call); (3) real iOS Safari + real Android Chrome verification; (4) R9 reduced-motion + high-contrast OS-mode contracts; (5) R10 print + export contracts; (6) R11 native pipeline render verification (Swift / Compose / Flutter); (7) R12 Storybook + a11y-tree per-state probes. **Historical — v0.13.4 (R8a Satoshi subset for LCP critical-path bytes):** [ADR 0027](_meta/decisions/0027-satoshi-subset-mobile-perf-v0134.md) closes R7's only Needs-Improvement metric by surgically dropping unused codepoints + glyphs from both Satoshi VF woff2 files (42 KB → 30 KB regular, 44 KB → 31 KB italic = 25.6 KB saved on the LCP critical path). 230 codepoints / 303 glyphs kept (ASCII + Latin-1 + General Punctuation + Currency + Letterlike + arrows + used Math + geometric shapes + ✓ +  PUA); every Lumen-referenced OpenType feature preserved (kern, liga, calt, ss01–ss04, tnum, lnum, sinf, sups, frac, case, locl, salt, dnom, numr); variable axis preserved (wght 300–900). Dropped: Latin Extended-A (Eastern European), IPA, combining diacritics, Greek, unsupported box drawing. **LCP geo-mean: 3030 → 2861 ms (−169 ms, −5.6%); `/foundations` standout −572 ms (drops out of Needs Improvement entirely).** [`scripts/subset-satoshi.mjs`](/scripts/subset-satoshi.mjs) is the declarative + re-runnable subsetter. **Historical — v0.13.3 (R7 pipeline-state + lint-hygiene + pre-commit SSoT regen + mobile-perf baseline):** [ADR 0026](_meta/decisions/0026-sd-pipeline-lint-hygiene-pre-commit-v0133.md). SD source-exclusion fix (93 collisions + 1 reference error → 0 actionable); token-naming kebab-case migration (45 paths across 16 component-token files); `lint:no-primitives` allowlist convention + 45 showcase block-allowlists (`pnpm lint` 7-rule umbrella → 0 violations); pre-commit hook for SSoT regen (`simple-git-hooks` registers `scripts/precommit-regen-indices.mjs`). First mobile Lighthouse baseline captured: Perf 94 geo-mean, **CLS 0.000 on every route**, TBT 12 ms (16× under threshold), with LCP the only Needs-Improvement metric. Methodology contribution: *passing validators is a producer-side green; passing consumer-side metrics is a separate axis. Both ship together.* **Historical — v0.13.2 (R6 senior-UX audit pass: LLM-docs SSoT additions + drift cleanup + a11y closeout cascade):** [ADR 0025](_meta/decisions/0025-audit-cycle-ladder-r6-llm-docs-ssot-v0132.md) formalizes the audit-cycle ladder at six rounds and ships R6's closures. Six new SSoT documents for LLM discoverability (auto-generated [`COMPONENT-INDEX.md`](/COMPONENT-INDEX.md), auto-generated [`TOKEN-INDEX.md`](/TOKEN-INDEX.md), [`audit-dashboard/README.md`](/audit-dashboard/README.md) + [`audit-dashboard/ROUTES.md`](/audit-dashboard/ROUTES.md), and three new foundation docs [`data-visualization.md`](/design-system/00-foundations/data-visualization.md) + [`responsive.md`](/design-system/00-foundations/responsive.md) + [`state-matrix.md`](/design-system/00-foundations/state-matrix.md)). 87 `validate:tokens` errors → 0 via 6 new/extended semantic token files. `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` (audit-dashboard) → PASS. Primitive-layer a11y cascade: Switch + Checkbox + Field children + NumberInput + TagsInput + RangeSlider + TypeToConfirm all gain aria-* forwarding (post-fix probe: 714 interactive elements across 8 routes at 320 × 568 px, 0 nameless). `scripts/release.mjs` widened to four more drift sites + safety guard. nav.tsx showcase exports renamed FAB → FABDemo etc. **Historical — v0.13.1 (R5 responsive safety net + a11y closeout + R4-deferred primitive coverage gap):** [ADR 0024](_meta/decisions/0024-responsive-safety-net-v0131.md) ships `html, body { overflow-x: clip }` at the root of `audit-dashboard/src/app/globals.css` — closes the mobile-viewport-inflation bug R4 carried as blocked. At 320 / 375 px, every route was reporting `innerWidth = 509` because descendants whose intrinsic min-content exceeded the device viewport (foundations typography "Stop re-designing." at 128 px needs ~440 px; library showcase Cards need ~484 px) inflated the layout viewport per the CSS Working Group spec, breaking every `sm:` and `md:` Tailwind utility silently. `clip` (not `hidden`) preserves the v0.12.6 sticky-header scroll-root contract. Plus 10 a11y findings closed (Switch + Checkbox gain `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`; ProgressRing `aria-hidden` when no label; DatePickerCalendar empty cells become passive; ProductGallery thumbs ship tablist + tab pattern; PricingToggle / Kanban "+" / ChatComposer "+" / mobile-inbox search all gained `aria-label`), the R4-deferred primitive coverage gap closed (5 new `component.md` + 7 new `examples/primary.tsx`), two new theme-invariant semantic tokens (`--label-overlay-strong` / `--label-overlay-fg`), and color-literal hygiene retired three legacy hex literals (SwatchRamp `rgba(0,0,0,0.55)` → token; ColorPicker `#171A18` → `#0D0D0D`; commerce "Brick" `#e23b3b` → `#a8403a` AA-pass). **Methodology contribution:** R5 adds small-viewport metrics as the fifth axis to the audit-cycle ladder (R1 static @ desktop → R2 interaction @ desktop → R3 contract-comparison @ desktop → R4 meta-contract @ desktop → R5 mobile-viewport metrics @ mobile). Each round ramps the tooling along with the surface coverage; *a carried blocker is a tooling hypothesis, not a fact*. **Historical** — v0.13.0 (2026-05-18) was **LLM-docs version lockstep + R4 comprehensive audit.** [ADR 0023](_meta/decisions/0023-llm-docs-version-lockstep-v013.md) extends the v0.12.5 single-source-of-truth pattern from the runtime UI to the LLM-facing prose layer: `scripts/release.mjs` rewrites the "Status: vX.Y.Z" chips in `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `README.md`, `USING-LUMEN.md`, and `PRIMITIVE-COVERAGE.md` in lockstep with `VERSION` and `audit-dashboard/src/lib/version.ts`. R4's audit caught those five files reading v0.12.5 / v0.12.6 banners while the runtime was already at v0.12.9 — exactly the drift class v0.12.5's runtime-UI SSoT closed at the rendered-UI layer. `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` top callouts remain hand-rewritten per release because they carry per-cycle narrative prose, not just a chip. R1 (v0.12.7 — chrome bleed), R2 (v0.12.8 — Commerce variant pickers), R3 (v0.12.9 — Calendar dynamic / iOS StatusBar / Tool presets client island), R4 (v0.13.0 — same-day comprehensive audit) had already shipped the desktop visual / interaction surface fixes. _Historical_ — v0.12.6 (2026-05-16) was the primitive coverage drop. 63 new component contracts close the LLM-facing gap between system primitives and the Apple HIG / Material / Polaris / Atlassian feature surface. Navigation, feedback, display, container, mobile, advanced-display, charts, AI + collaboration, form gaps, commerce/marketing all now ship contracts (see [`PRIMITIVE-COVERAGE.md`](/PRIMITIVE-COVERAGE.md) for the gap-to-coverage master map and [`CHANGELOG v0.12.6`](/CHANGELOG.md) for the per-component summary). 98 contracts in `_registry/registry.json` as of v0.12.6 (35 prior + 63 new). v0.12.5 (2026-05-07) — live-audit fix pack: New `audit-dashboard/src/lib/version.ts` hoists the user-facing version label to a single constant (`LUMEN_VERSION`); every consumer (header pill, footer line, palette footer, foundations brand-voice samples, library / tool / foundations badges) reads from it; the v0.11.13 → v0.12.4 audit found the palette footer three minor versions stale because no one had grepped the literal — the constant retires that whole class of drift. Iconography hover lifts icon to `text-accent` + tile border to `border-accent` (teaches "green appears at action" visually). Pricing card peak-end hover lift on landing (Starter / Enterprise: `shadow-md` + `border-default` + `-translate-y-[1px]`; Operator: soft accent glow). Landing FAQ disclosure caret migrates from Unicode `▾` to lucide `ChevronDown`; new `.lumen-summary` + `summary.list-none` CSS rule suppresses the native browser disclosure marker so the lucide icon is the sole disclosure cue on every browser. Privacy scrub: real-person names retired from 9 sites in 5 files, replaced with synthetic operator names. v0.12.5 ships without a new ADR — five surgical fixes consequential to ADRs 0007 + 0009 + 0018. v0.12.4 — three primitive-layer fixes: InlineTabs pill `overflow-hidden`, Combobox dropdown portaled, global `:focus-visible` gains `outline + offset` on top of soft box-shadow halo. v0.12.3 — Tailwind v4 arbitrary-translate fragility retired (cascade-fix to ADR 0015/0016 — inline `style.left` / `style.transform`). v0.12.2 — primary-button hover bloom dialed down ([ADR 0022](_meta/decisions/0022-hover-glow-ladder-retune-v0122.md)). v0.12.1 — Card corner-clip contract for `padding="none"` ([ADR 0021](_meta/decisions/0021-card-corner-clip-contract-v0121.md)). v0.12.0 — Obsidian Mint retired ([ADR 0020](_meta/decisions/0020-obsidian-recolor-mint-retired-v012.md)) — canvas is neutral near-black at `#0D0D0D`, R = G = B at every dark stop.

If you are an AI coding agent, read these in order:

## Core (read first)
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Universal agent rules. Highest-priority hard rules for any work in this repo. Read first.
- [CLAUDE.md](/CLAUDE.md): Claude-specific addenda on top of AGENTS.md.
- [USING-LUMEN.md](/USING-LUMEN.md): Comprehensive end-to-end manual — every system tier, every consumption surface, every governance rule, every compositional pattern, every anti-pattern in one document. Read this when you need the unified narrative.
- [README.md](/README.md): Human-facing front door.
- [COMPONENT-INDEX.md](/COMPONENT-INDEX.md): Auto-generated flat index of all 98 components — purpose, version, status, examples per component. Regenerate with `pnpm component-index` after any component contract change. (v0.13.2 — closes the 35-vs-98 catalog drift in USING-LUMEN.md §5.)
- [TOKEN-INDEX.md](/TOKEN-INDEX.md): Auto-generated flat index of all semantic + component-bound tokens (~750 tokens) with alias targets and descriptions. Regenerate with `pnpm token-index`. Primitive tier intentionally omitted per AGENTS.md hard rule 2 — consume only semantic. (v0.13.2.)
- [Token taxonomy](/design-system/01-tokens/README.md): Three-layer system (primitives → semantic → component). Engineers and LLMs only consume semantic.
- [Component schema](/design-system/02-components/_schema/component.schema.json): JSON schema every component contract validates against.
- [audit-dashboard/README.md](/audit-dashboard/README.md): How to run, where things live, how the runtime version label + theme + responsive safety net work. (v0.13.2 — closes audit-dashboard onboarding gap.)
- [audit-dashboard/ROUTES.md](/audit-dashboard/ROUTES.md): One-stop route index for the 9 dashboard routes — purpose, audience, primitives demonstrated, audit-cycle cross-reference. (v0.13.2.)
- [Synthesised brief](/research/lumen-brief.md): Why every major decision was made.
- [ADR 0018 — v0.11 Premium Psychology recolor](/_meta/decisions/0018-premium-psychology-recolor.md): The premium-psychology contract (amended by 0020 for the v0.12 canvas retune; preserved verbatim for principles, hierarchy, micro-interactions).
- [ADR 0020 — v0.12 Obsidian recolor (mint retired)](/_meta/decisions/0020-obsidian-recolor-mint-retired-v012.md): The current canvas contract — neutral `#0D0D0D`, R = G = B at every dark stop.
- [ADR 0021 — v0.12.1 Card corner-clip contract](/_meta/decisions/0021-card-corner-clip-contract-v0121.md): `<Card padding="none">` auto-clips edge-touching children to the rounded shape.
- [ADR 0022 — v0.12.2 Hover-glow ladder retune](/_meta/decisions/0022-hover-glow-ladder-retune-v0122.md): Primary-button hover bloom dialed down at the token + layered-halo level. Rest stays put (brand voice); hover trims.
- [CHANGELOG v0.12.3 entry](/CHANGELOG.md): No new ADR — cascade-fix to ADR 0015/0016 in toggle/swipe territory. **Pattern for LLMs:** thumb / swipe / handle position math uses inline `style.left` (or `style.transform`), not Tailwind arbitrary `translate-x-[Npx]` classes. The Tailwind v4 content scanner has been observed to drop arbitrary-translate utilities; inline styles are scanner-independent.
- [CHANGELOG v0.12.4 entry](/CHANGELOG.md): Three primitive-layer fixes, no new ADR — they're consequential follow-ups to ADRs 0007 + 0015/0016 + 0021. **Patterns for LLMs:** (1) any rounded-parent + square-cornered-child container needs `overflow-hidden` (the corner-clip pattern extends from Card to InlineTabs pill — same root cause at the smaller-control scale); (2) any floating popover / dropdown / autocomplete must portal to `document.body` via `createPortal` + `position: fixed` + `getBoundingClientRect()` tracking — inline `<div absolute>` panels get clipped by ancestor overflow contexts (Showcase frames, `<Card padding="none">`, glass surfaces, scroll containers); (3) global `:focus-visible` rides `outline + box-shadow` — outline paints outside the layout box and is structurally immune to ancestor `overflow: hidden`, so focus rings stay visible inside corner-clipped containers; box-shadow continues to paint the soft brand halo when unclipped.
- [CHANGELOG v0.12.5 entry](/CHANGELOG.md): Five surgical fixes from a two-round live visual audit, no new ADR — consequential follow-ups to ADRs 0007 + 0009 + 0018. **Patterns for LLMs:** (1) every user-facing version label imports from [`audit-dashboard/src/lib/version.ts`](/audit-dashboard/src/lib/version.ts) — never hardcode a literal — three exports cover the three rendering contexts (`LUMEN_VERSION`, `LUMEN_VERSION_MAJOR_MINOR`, `LUMEN_VERSION_MAJOR_MINOR_UPPER`); the release script bumps both the root `VERSION` file and `lib/version.ts` in lockstep; (2) every custom `<details>`/`<summary>` accordion that composes its own end-of-summary chevron icon gets `class="lumen-summary"` (or `list-none`) so the native browser disclosure marker is suppressed on every browser — without it the native triangle competes with the lucide chevron; (3) interactive icon tiles hover to `text-accent` + `border-accent` so the brand rule "green appears precisely at action" is taught visually, not just in prose; (4) interactive cards at peak moments (pricing tier selection, plan picker) gain hover lift via the existing system tokens — non-highlighted: `shadow-md` + `border-default` + `-translate-y-[1px]`; highlighted: layer `var(--shadow-glow-accent)`; (5) fixtures and demos use synthetic operator names — never real people from the user's vault (the v0.12.5 audit retired `Sokolovsky` and `Tengariya` from 9 sites in 5 files, replaced with `Avery Mercer` / `Kai Morgan`).

## Foundations (17 docs)
- [Principles](/design-system/00-foundations/principles.md): The seven operating principles (v0.11 grew from 5 to 7).
- [Hierarchy](/design-system/00-foundations/hierarchy.md): v0.11 — aggressive hierarchy / one focal point per section.
- [First impression](/design-system/00-foundations/first-impression.md): v0.11 — 50ms halo, hero anatomy, cold-load contract.
- [Micro-interactions](/design-system/00-foundations/micro-interactions.md): v0.11 — peak-end rule, the catalog of moments.
- [Color](/design-system/00-foundations/color.md): The four-color floor — accent #00FA8A (Spring Green), dark #0D0D0D (neutral obsidian, v0.12 — mint retired), light #E6E6E6, paper #FAFAFA.
- [Typography](/design-system/00-foundations/typography.md): Satoshi-only single-typeface system.
- [Spacing](/design-system/00-foundations/spacing.md): 4-pt base / 8-pt soft grid; marketing-vs-operator section split.
- [Elevation](/design-system/00-foundations/elevation.md): Hairline + two-stop shadows; accent-glow signature.
- [Voice & tone](/design-system/00-foundations/voice-and-tone.md): How Lumen sounds.
- [Accessibility](/design-system/00-foundations/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AA floor — non-negotiable.
- [Motion language](/design-system/00-foundations/motion-language.md): Timing tokens, easing, choreography.
- [Density](/design-system/00-foundations/density.md): Marketing-vs-operator split.
- [Buttons](/design-system/00-foundations/buttons.md): The comprehensive button language (5 sizes × 8 intents × 3 shapes). v0.12.2 dialed the primary-hover glow ladder down: rest 16px a25 → hover 20px a28 (was 24px a40) → active 8px a20.
- [Forms and inputs](/design-system/00-foundations/forms-and-inputs.md): The v0.6 .lumen-field shell architecture.
- [Data visualization](/design-system/00-foundations/data-visualization.md): When to use which chart, axes / legend rules, color rules, accessibility, empty/loading/error states. (v0.13.2 — new.)
- [Responsive](/design-system/00-foundations/responsive.md): Breakpoints, layout-viewport contract (`overflow-x: clip` per ADR 0024), sub-768 px authoring rules, audit-cycle viewport ladder. (v0.13.2 — new; codifies ADR 0024 for consumers.)
- [State matrix](/design-system/00-foundations/state-matrix.md): The 13 canonical states (default, hover, focus, active, selected, pressed, disabled, loading, error, success, warning, empty, expanded, dragging, read-only, skeleton) and which primitives must support which subset. (v0.13.2 — new.)

The CHANGELOG entries carry the architectural notes those would-be ADRs would have held.

## Quick LLM playbook (v0.12.5)

When generating UI in this system, default to these defensive patterns. Each one was earned by a specific bug — what every v0.12.x cascade-fix retired the alternative for:

1. **Token references, never hex.** `var(--color-action-primary-bg-rest)` ✓ — `#00FA8A` ✗. Reach for `_build/css/tokens.css` if you need the variable list.
2. **Semantic tokens, never primitives.** `color.surface.page` ✓ — `color.brand.800` ✗.
3. **Defensive button classes, never shadcn bridge utilities on accent.** `.lumen-btn-primary` ✓ — `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` ✗ on accent surfaces (Tailwind v4 scanner has been observed to drop the bridge utility, leaving white-on-spring-green at ~1.4:1 — WCAG fail).
4. **Inline `style.left` for thumb / swipe / handle position math, never Tailwind arbitrary translates.** `style={{ left: open ? 22 : 2 }}` ✓ — `className="translate-x-[22px]"` ✗ (the v0.12.3 cascade-fix retired this on PricingToggle + SwipeAction; the same fragility applies to any new toggle / handle / thumb primitive).
5. **`createPortal` + `position: fixed` for floating UI, never inline `<div absolute>`.** Combobox / Select / DropdownMenu / Popover / Tooltip / Calendar all portal to `document.body`. Inline absolute panels get clipped by ancestor `overflow: hidden` — Showcase frames, `<Card padding="none">`, glass surfaces, scroll containers.
6. **`overflow-hidden` on rounded-parent + square-cornered-child containers.** Card primitive does this on `padding="none"`; InlineTabs pill variant does this on its `TabsList`. Any new rounded container hosting children with their own backgrounds + square corners needs the same clip.
7. **`outline + box-shadow` for focus rings, never box-shadow alone.** The global `:focus-visible` rule paints both. Outline is structurally immune to ancestor `overflow: hidden`; box-shadow paints the soft brand halo when unclipped. Don't write a new `:focus-visible` rule with `box-shadow` only.
8. **Honor `prefers-reduced-motion` in everything that animates.** No exceptions; lint enforces.
9. **Version labels read from `lib/version.ts`, never hardcoded literals.** `import { LUMEN_VERSION } from "@/lib/version"` ✓ — `<span>v0.12.5</span>` ✗. Three exports for three contexts: `LUMEN_VERSION` for patch-level chips, `LUMEN_VERSION_MAJOR_MINOR` for inline references, `LUMEN_VERSION_MAJOR_MINOR_UPPER` for explicit uppercased brand-voice tokens. Release script bumps `lib/version.ts` in lockstep with the root `VERSION` file. The v0.12.5 fix retired one stale `v0.11.13` palette footer + 8 hardcoded `v0.12.4` chips + 2 `SYSTEM V0.11` brand-voice samples.
10. **`<details>` accordions suppress the native marker — always — when composing your own chevron.** `<summary class="lumen-summary"><span>{q}</span><ChevronDown ... /></summary>` ✓ — bare `<summary>` (browser shows native triangle PLUS your chevron) ✗. The `globals.css` `.lumen-summary` rule covers modern browsers via `list-style: none` + the standard `::marker`; pre-2022 webkit via `::-webkit-details-marker { display: none }`. Tailwind utility `list-none` triggers the same rule pair.
11. **Interactive icon tiles hover to accent.** `hover:bg-[var(--surface-tint-accent)] hover:text-[color:var(--text-accent)] hover:border-[var(--border-accent)]` ✓ — `hover:bg-tint-accent` alone (only background tints) ✗. The hover state is what teaches the brand rule "green appears precisely at action." If your icon stays neutral on hover, the rule is buried in prose; if it lifts to accent, every user feels it on their first hover.
12. **Interactive peak-moment cards lift on hover.** Pricing tier cards, plan-picker cards, primary action tiles — non-highlighted: `hover:shadow-[var(--shadow-md)] hover:border-[var(--border-default)] hover:-translate-y-[1px]`; highlighted: layer `var(--shadow-glow-accent)`. Static peak-moment cards are an LLM-UI smell — the model knows they exist but doesn't know they're peak moments.
13. **Synthetic names in fixtures and demos.** No real-person names — Avery Mercer / Kai Morgan / Jordan Kim style synthetic operator names. Carrier names are safe (Sterling LTL, ODFL, Saia, FedEx Freight, ABF — public B2B identities, not customer data).
14. **Add a CHANGELOG entry for every PR.** Keep-a-Changelog format, under one of Added/Changed/Deprecated/Removed/Fixed/Security.
